title: Reduce Egocentric Bias
description: When recalling events: - Use evidence: Look at photos, reports, or other objective records of what happened. - Ask others: Gather perspectives from those who were there. - Reflect honestly: Recognize moments where your memory might exaggerate your role or success. Example: If you remember organizing a successful event, check with others to confirm your recollection.
